question: extras.persistent_storage.included_gib is named in GiB, but compute records store the provider's stated GB figure in it (compute/lightning-ai 10 GB, and for example compute/oracle-cloud, compute/github-codespaces, compute/neon and compute/supabase). Should the field gain a unit key or be renamed, so a stated decimal figure is not labelled GiB?
why: docs/conventions section 4.1 forbids both converting a stated decimal figure to binary and printing one unit while labelling it another; the field name forces one of the two
